_doc: Repo-local Claude Code settings for RytmRandomizer.
Post-push code review is enforced by three mechanisms (see
docs/CODE_REVIEW_HOOK_SETUP.md):
1. .githooks/pre-push runs the mechanical gates (lint + architecture +
V1.34 parity) via scripts/code_review_gate.py for ANY tool once
core.hooksPath is set (`just install` does this).
2. .codex/hooks.json — the codex PostToolUse command hook that
re-prompts the 8-step code-review skill after a `git push`.
3. The CI `architecture` job enforces the same gates server-side.
This file previously declared a Claude Code PostToolUse `Agent` hook (a
matcher OBJECT plus an `action.Agent` block). The installed Claude Code
validates `matcher` as a STRING with a nested `hooks` array of
`type: command` entries, so that shape failed settings validation
("settings file failed to parse / expected string, received object") and
was removed. A `command` hook cannot dispatch the code-reviewer agent, so
until a native Agent-type hook is supported here, run the review on demand
with the /code-review skill (or the code-reviewer agent in
.claude/agents/code-reviewer.md). The pre-push hook and the CI
`architecture` job keep the review enforced regardless.
See docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and .claude/rules/architecture.md for the
architecture spec the review enforces.
